checked_by: Developer inspection of the saved overlays (red dots = extracted samples drawn on the working image), 11 October 2026
method: Each overlay in manual/ was opened and compared by eye with the drawn curve: does every sample sit on the selected curve, are there jumps to other objects, are gaps visible?

checks.note: Samples follow the single blue curve from the baseline through the front, crest and tail; no samples on grid lines, labels or the title.

After rectification from the four plot corners the grid is square and the samples follow the curve. On the near-vertical front only one sample per pixel column is drawn (column centre), so the blue line shows between the red dots there; this is the intended representation, not a gap.
Samples run along the centre of the 6 px stroke over the whole record. Front error +3.0% stays inside the reported digitization spread.

Samples stay on the selected (upper) curve; the lower same-colour curve is not mixed in. Where the two curves merge on the front they cannot be told apart, which is why the case is flagged 'multiple same-colour curves' and quantitative diagnosis is disabled.

limitation: Four overlays checked by one person on generated images. This is a sanity check of the extraction, not a measurement of accuracy on laboratory photos.
